turns.question: What share of non-cancelled order revenue between 17 August and 2 October 2026 came from orders that have no return at all, in percent?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no such metric: revenue cannot be split by whether an order has a return, so I cannot give the share of revenue from orders with no return. The closest metrics are revenue_eur (Revenue), returns_eur (Returns), returns_count and returns_on_order_date (Returns by order date), net_revenue_eur (Net revenue, revenue minus partner returns) and return_rate (share of orders returned).
